title: Corporate — the GOA side
summary: Rootful-podman container instance behind a reverse proxy, directory (LDAP) auth, many operators, Windows deploy targets. Promotion runs through an administrator-approved path on an unprivileged account with no npm-registry access.
evidenceNote: NOT read from the live instance — this workspace cannot reach it. Every value below is reconstructed from repo source (app/isolation.js, app/server.js, app/user-credentials.js, deploy/host/README.md), DEPLOY.md's knob table and DECISIONS.md. Treat it as a proposal to confirm: one `systemctl show project-workbench -p Environment` from a GOA operator turns this into evidence. Until then do not generate a GOA environment file from it.
notes: Turn outcomes (Jev) must never ship here: forbiddenEnv above makes DECISIONS.md 2026-10-05 a test failure instead of a sentence someone has to remember.
The container is recreated from the image on every (re)start, so anything not baked or persisted is re-applied by the hostHooks as systemd ExecStartPost.
install.sh at the repo root refuses PW_DEPLOY_MODE=container by design (install.sh:34); this environment never runs it.
The Deploy Centre (app/deployment/, ~6100 lines) is off by default everywhere and on only here.
